title: Truth Table — Borrowing Relationship Tolerance on the Class H Preferred Stock Quarterly Purchase Allowance, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The quarter-limit relationship tolerance of a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock purchase rests on the member's borrowing with the association: a member with an active farm real estate loan whose principal balance is 250000 or more and an active operating line gets USD 10000; a member with only one of those two gets USD 5000; a member with neither gets none.

## Truth table

| Active farm real estate loan (Farm Real Estate Loans) with a principal balance of 250000 or more | Active operating line (Operating Lines of Credit) | Tolerance |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | USD 10000 |
| Yes | No | USD 5000 |
| No | Yes | USD 5000 |
| No | No | None |

The tolerance is a dollar amount added to the quarter's purchase allowance before the excess is taken.

## Records read

- Farm Real Estate Loans: the loan's status (active) and its principal balance. An active farm real estate loan with a principal balance below 250000 does not meet the first condition.
- Operating Lines of Credit: whether an operating line in active status stands, with its commitment.

## Cases (hypothetical members)

| Borrowing | Tolerance |
|---|---|
| Active farm real estate loan, principal 310,000.00; active operating line | USD 10000 |
| Active farm real estate loan, principal 180,000.00; active operating line | USD 5000 — only the operating line counts |
| Active farm real estate loan, principal 250,000.00; no operating line | USD 5000 |
| Active farm real estate loan, principal 180,000.00; no operating line | None |
